questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why jogging and swimming are good for you
The history of the European football championship
Concussion in sport and its long-term effects
How to become a professional boxer
questions.why: Georgina says the topic is concussion, a brain injury caused by a blow to the head.

questions.q: Why do the presenters mention Christian Eriksen?
options: His collapse brought sports safety back into the news
He is a famous boxer who was badly hurt in a fight
He was concussed during an international hockey match
He writes newspaper articles about brain injuries
questions.why: Neil says safety in sport was back in the news when Eriksen collapsed on the pitch.

questions.q: What are people mainly worried about in this debate?
options: Players and managers earning far too much money
Broken legs and arms from dangerous tackles
Too many matches being played in one season
Brain damage and dementia caused by concussion
questions.why: Georgina says at the centre of the debate are worries about brain damage and dementia caused by concussion.

questions.q: How did Nicola White get concussed?
options: She fell and hit her head while jogging in the park
She collided with another player in a warm-up match
She was hit by a hockey ball in the Olympic final
She hit her head on the side of a swimming pool
questions.why: She was involved in a heavy collision with another player during a warm-up match in 2018.

questions.q: How does Nicola describe how she felt after the accident?
options: Tired for a few days but otherwise completely fine
Angry with the other player for playing so roughly
Like she was in a strange, unpleasant world
Happy to take a long break from training and sport
questions.why: She says it was like being in Alice in Wonderland, 'in such a warped world'.

questions.q: What does Paul Connolly say about Nicola three years later?
options: She has fully recovered
Many of her symptoms are still there
She has started boxing
She refused to see any specialists
questions.why: He says that despite treatment from specialists, many of her symptoms persist.

questions.q: What point does Nicola's story show?
options: Only boxers and rugby players really get concussion
Hockey is now more dangerous than boxing or rugby
Olympic athletes almost never get seriously injured
Concussion can happen in sports that aren't full contact
questions.why: Neil says concussion is a problem even in sports like hockey that are not considered 'full contact'.

questions.q: What is special about boxing's rules, according to the presenters?
options: Concussion is actually written into them
They ban all punches to the head
They allow only ten punches per round
They require a doctor in the ring
questions.why: Georgina says boxing is one of the few sports with concussion written into the rules.
